paper_metadata.title: The Potential of Quantum Techniques for Stock Price Prediction

experiments.description: Quantum annealing-based feature selection on stock-market indicator data, used to reduce the feature set to 3, 5, or 8 features before downstream prediction/classification.

algorithm.variant: Quantum Annealing for feature selection formulated as QUBO

hyperparameters.objective: maximize relevance of selected features while minimizing redundancies and irrelevant features

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Each feature is represented by a binary variable xi in {0,1}; selected features are encoded as 1 and unselected as 0.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize Q(x) = x^T q x = sum_{i=1..N} sum_{j=i+1..N} q_ij x_i x_j
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: No explicit constraints; formulated as QUBO on a quantum annealer.

problem_instance.description: Feature selection over stock-market indicators extracted from real stock data for Apple, Visa, Johnson & Johnson, and Honeywell.

dataset_specification.description: Tickers: HON, JNJ, AAPL, VISA; date range: 2020-12-25 to 2022-12-25; raw inputs include closing, high, and low prices; indicators computed include MA, RSI, MACD, stochastic oscillator, ATR, and Aroon.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Indicator extraction from historical OHLC data; dimensionality reduction/feature selection to QA3, QA5, QA8.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Compared downstream model performance using QA-reduced datasets; average accuracy and F-score reported across the four companies.

hardware.framework: D-Wave Quantum Annealing Computers / QUBO formulation

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Feature extraction from raw stock prices; correlation-based QUBO construction.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Selected feature subset used to train downstream classical/quantum classifiers.

speedup_claims.caveats: No explicit speedup claim for quantum annealing feature selection; paper reports comparative predictive performance only.

experiments.description: Quantum support vector classification on PCA-reduced stock-price feature sets using ZZ feature maps with multiple entanglement schemes.

algorithm.variant: QSVC / QSVM with ZZ Feature Map

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Classical features are encoded into quantum states via the ZZ Feature Map; entanglement captures feature correlations.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Binary classification of next-day stock movement: Change = 1 if Price_T < Price_T+1, else 0.

problem_instance.description: Binary classification of stock price movement (up/down) for four companies using reduced feature sets.

dataset_specification.description: Tickers: HON, JNJ, AAPL, VISA; date range: 2020-12-25 to 2022-12-25; reduced datasets PCA-3, PCA-5, PCA-8 derived from extracted indicators.

problem_instance.data_preprocessing_details: Raw OHLC data from yfinance; technical indicators computed; PCA applied to obtain 3, 5, and 8 feature datasets.
problem_instance.evaluation_methodology: Accuracy and F-score reported; compared across entanglement schemes and PCA sizes; 8-feature QSVC models failed to train due to insufficient computational power.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: PCA dimensionality reduction on technical-indicator feature set.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Classification of predicted labels and computation of accuracy/F-score.

speedup_claims.caveats: No explicit runtime or asymptotic speedup claim; only classification performance comparisons are reported.

algorithm.variant: QSVM / QSVC with ZZ Feature Map on QA-reduced features

problem_formulation.objective_function: Binary classification of next-day stock movement (up/down).

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Quantum annealing feature selection on Honeywell indicator set.

speedup_claims.caveats: No runtime speedup claim; paper notes QSVM did not show significant advantage over classical SVM on these datasets.
